translation: Yet the learners of today, when they come, immediately ask: If I go to a teacher and am taught for ten days, is that enough? If they are all this hasty, then even though I wish to transmit, from where can I transmit? Alas! The learning of the world is generally like this; is it only medicine? The gentleman of antiquity, in regard to the Way, at the beginning only urgently sought a person; and when he could not obtain a person to seek, then he had no choice but to take up the matter of books, hoping that they would long endure between Heaven and Earth. In regard to books, he did not necessarily need to write books himself, but to make manifest the hidden and continue the cut off, and to seek to preserve the books of the ancients. The books of the ancients, relying on later people of mind to obtain circulation in the world, are many. At first it is not necessary that all later people have mind and all love learning and be able to read; but the book cannot bear not to be preserved, thinking that if there is one person in ten thousand who has mind and loves learning and is able to read this book, then this one book is not preserved in vain. Even after a hundred generations there should be a person who comes forth and looks at today's Master Cheng Jingtong, just as Master Cheng looks at the two gentlemen, Prefect Wang and Censor-in-Chief Sun of the Tang and Song. Then to the person who comes to Master Cheng's gate today wishing to learn all he has learned in ten days, Master Cheng can also decline him without owing anything.
